# Lenz Pracher

> Personal website of Lenz Pracher — physics / machine-learning researcher (LMU).
> Research write-ups on deep learning theory: learning dynamics, the neural
> tangent kernel, and grokking.

## Writing

- [A Spectral Theory of Grokking](https://lenzpracher.github.io/projects/grokking/): How weight decay drives grokking through evolution of the neural tangent kernel.
